title: BuildersSMP
description: building focused community survival server focused on building, progression, and fun features like land claims, player shops, custom farming, fishing, and more.
body:
# 🧱 Welcome to BuildersSMP 🧱

## 🔗Links
🌐**Website:** [BuildersSMP.com](https://builderssmp.com/)

🕹️**Discord:** [discord.gg/yWeZ8Yz8sZ](https://discord.gg/yWeZ8Yz8sZ)

📚**Wiki:** [BuildersSMP.com/wiki](https://builderssmp.com/wiki)

## 📖Info

> BuildersSMP is a survival server built for players who love building, exploring, and playing with a community. The goal is simple — keep the classic survival experience while adding fun features that make the game more rewarding.
### 🌍 Build Without Worry
> We have a land claiming system so your builds stay protected and can’t be griefed.

### 🏪 Player Shops
> Players can buy and sell materials and building blocks, making it easier to get what you need and spend more time building instead of grinding.

### 🎨 Creative World
> Want to test a build idea first? We also have a creative world where you can experiment and design freely.

### 📈 Skills & Progression
> Level up MMO-style skills and enjoy fun progression systems while you play.

### 🌱 Farming & Crops
> Grow custom crops and take care of them like a farming game. Use them to decorate builds or sell them for money.

### 🎣 Custom Fishing
> Fish across different biomes to catch unique custom fish that you can collect or sell.

### 🏠 Homes
> Save multiple /homes so you can easily teleport between your builds and favorite spots.

### 🤝 Friendly Community
> Work on projects with friends, explore the world, and be part of a growing server.
